---

## Annotations

### 1. Conflicting Evidence

**Finding 1 — Birth date (Find a Grave index):** The index gives **31 Jan 1839**; the profile gives **30 Nov 1838**. All other markers (death date, burial place) confirm it is the same person. No other attached source gives any exact birth date. **Action:** Re-read the tombstone photo attached to this memorial (memory 7349489) to settle which date it records. Keep the source attached.

**Finding 2 — Surname keyed as "Mollman" / "...Allman":** Two Vermont Deaths and Burials index entries miskey Edward's surname (F8R4-RYM: "Mollman"; F8RW-X4N: "...Allman"). The surrounding details in F8R4-RYM all fit Edward. **Action:** Re-read the register page image for F8R4-RYM and submit an index correction. Same for F8RW-X4N. Keep both sources attached.

**Finding 3 — Father's given name in 1913 death indexes:** One entry keys the father as "Joo," another as "Jas," and a third as "Joseph." The 1850 census household head is Joseph. These are likely misreadings of one handwritten death entry. **Action:** Re-read the death register page image (available for 2V7M-JMY) to confirm the father's given name and correct the index accordingly.

### 2. Patterns in Consistent Evidence

- **Death (16 Aug 1913, Burlington, VT):** Five independent sources agree — this is the strongest conclusion on the profile.
- **Wife Clarissa Wade:** Supported by the 1870 & 1875 censuses, six Vermont children's marriage records (1890–1895), the 1913 death entries, and two 1943/1948 child death records.
- **Parents (Joseph Tallman & Jane Patterson):** 1850 census household plus three 1913 death-record entries (father's given name is garbled in two — see Finding 3).
- **Residences 1850–1910:** Each rests on a matching census.
- **Children Fannie, Helen, Blanche, Theodore, Phoebe, and Orrin:** Each appears in at least two independent attached records naming Edward as father.

### 3. Conclusions with No Support or Only Weak Support

| Conclusion | Status |
|---|---|
| Exact birth date (30 Nov 1838) | Only source (Find a Grave) **conflicts** — gives 31 Jan 1839. No other attached source confirms this. |
| Birth place "Peru" | Only one source (SMQJ-H81); all others give New York state only. |
| Marriage to Mary (~1860) | No marriage record attached; Mary appears only in the 1865 household (not labeled as wife). No month. |
| Marriage to Clarissa Wade (~1866) | No marriage record attached; supported only through household and children. No month. |
| Children Mary (1860) and Caroline (1863) | No attached source names either child. |
| Child Lilly (1865, d. Sep 1865) | Only the 1865 census; no death record attached. |
| Burial (Aug 1913) | Place only, from Find a Grave; no burial date and no cemetery name in any attached source. |

### 4. Overall Assessment

The profile is **well supported** on Edward's death, parentage, wife (from the 1870s onward), residences, and most children from the 1870s. These conclusions each rest on multiple independent records. The three actionable findings are all indexing or transcription errors correctable by re-reading the original images — none warrants detaching a source.

The weakest areas are the **exact birth date** (the one source that gives an exact date conflicts with the profile), the **two marriages** (no marriage records, no months), and the **three earliest children** from the first marriage. Those gaps represent genuine research opportunities rather than problems with the current evidence.

**Items not checked:**
- Two Vermont Vital Records entries (S8T1-4MC, XF2X-BYV) — record read failed.
- Burlington Free Press funeral notice (9J22-G6F) — external newspaper link; worth consulting for burial and death corroboration.
- Tombstone photo (memory 7349489) — image; key to resolving Finding 1.

Here is the source-evaluation agent's full report on **Cornelius Driscoll (GJ72-9WD)**:

---

## Sources Audit — 7 sources reviewed, 2 actionable findings, 1 conflict routed onward

---

### Finding 1 — Indexing Error (Marriage Year)
**Source:** "Quebec, Vital and Church Records (Drouin Collection), 1621-1968"

The index records the marriage as **9 June 1845**, but the profile records **9 June 1849**. The day, month, place (St. Patrick's, Sherbrooke), and spouse (Margaret Hayes) all agree — only the year differs.

**Next step:** Re-read the marriage register image in the Drouin Collection. If it reads **1849**, correct the index year on FamilySearch. If it reads **1845**, the profile's marriage date needs updating. Keep the source attached either way.

---

### Finding 2 — Unclassified (Residence Place, 1851 Census)
**Source:** "Census of Canada East, 1851"

Indexed residence: **Melbourne**, Canada East. The profile records **Sherbrooke**, Canada East for 1851. Birthplace (Ireland) agrees, but the index gives no age or household members, so it can't be confirmed as the right person.

**Next step:** Re-read the original 1851 census schedule (no image is currently attached to the index entry). Do **not** detach the source until that re-read settles whether this is an indexing error or a different person entirely.

---

### Finding 3 — Source-vs-Source Death Conflict (Routed to Conflict Resolution)
Two sources give incompatible death information:
- **Parish burial record** ("Quebec, Catholic Parish Registers, 1621-1979"): burial 14 April **1878**, St. Patrick's Cemetery, Sherbrooke
- **Civil death record** ("Quebec, Civil Registration Deaths, 1867-1900"): death 2 February **1885**, Sherbrooke

Both name a Cornelius born 1814 in Ireland. The profile currently records a burial with no date and no death fact. This conflict — a **7-year gap between death dates** — cannot be resolved by this audit and needs to go through **conflict-resolution**.

---

### Sources Confirmed as Agreeing with the Profile
- **Birth 1814, Ireland**: Christening 12 March 1814, Skibbereen, Cork — "Ireland, Catholic Parish Registers, 1655-1915." Consistent with the profile; this exact date actually refines it.
- **Residence 1861, Sherbrooke**: "Census of Canada, 1861" — agrees.
- **Burial, St. Patrick's Cemetery**: Parish burial record confirms the place. The 14 April 1878 date is an improvement the profile could adopt once Finding 3 is resolved.

---

### Cannot Check
- **Headstone photograph (uploaded memory)** — user upload, no record ID. It's a useful lead for the death-date conflict (Finding 3): compare the headstone inscription against both the parish burial record and the civil death entry.

---

### Summary of Actions Needed
| # | Action | Source |
|---|--------|--------|
| 1 | Re-read Drouin Collection image; correct whichever year is wrong (index or profile) | Drouin marriage record |
| 2 | Re-read 1851 census schedule; decide if this is an indexing error or the wrong person | 1851 Canada East census |
| 3 | Take to **conflict-resolution** — burial 1878 vs. civil death 1885 | Parish burial + civil death |

The audit has been logged as **log_001** in the project's research.json.

## Sources on Christian P. Hole (KD96-TV2) — 4 attached, 2 findings

**Minnesota Death Index, 1908–2002** (index only, no image)
[https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:HOLE-002](https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:HOLE-002)

The indexed death date is **10 June 1954**, but the profile shows **10 Jun 1945**. Everything else (name, birth year 1875, Norway, Erskine, Polk, Minnesota) fits this man. This is most likely an indexing error on the year.

**Minnesota State Census, 1885** — Christian Hole
[https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:HOLE-003](https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:HOLE-003)

This record shows a Christian Hole born **1852** in Norway, in Aurdal, Otter Tail, Minnesota in 1885, with wife Bergit (b. 1856) and son Nils (b. 1879). ### Finding 1 — Indexing Error (worst probable)
**Quebec, Vital and Church Records (Drouin Collection), 1621–1968**
The indexed marriage year is **1845**, but the profile records the marriage as **9 Jun 1849**, Sherbrooke. The names, place, day, and month all agree — only the year differs. This is likely an indexing error on one field, though which side is wrong cannot be settled without reading the original register page. **Next step:** re-read the marriage register image. **Quebec, Civil Registration Deaths, 1867–1900** vs. **Quebec, Catholic Parish Registers, 1621–1979**
- Civil death index: death **2 February 1885**, Sherbrooke
- Catholic burial record: burial **14 April 1878**, St. Patrick's Cemetery; death April 1878

The two death dates are **seven years apart**, and the burial date actually *precedes* the civil death date — an impossibility if both describe the same event. The profile records no death date, only the burial. **Route:** this is a conflict between two sources and needs a formal conflict-resolution review. Neither record should be detached on this evidence alone. The uploaded headstone photograph may also be worth consulting alongside the burial register.

---

**Census of Canada East, 1851**
Indexed residence: **Melbourne**, Canada East. Profile records **Sherbrooke**, Canada East in 1851. Birth in Ireland agrees. Melbourne is not part of Sherbrooke, so this is not an indexing variant — it may be an indexing error on the place, or it may be a different household/person. **Next step:** re-read the 1851 census schedule entry. Do not detach on this evidence alone.

---

- **Census of Canada, 1861**: agrees on residence at Sherbrooke; birth year 1816 is within two years of profile (not a finding). ✓

---

One uploaded headstone photograph ("Driscoll headstone photograph, St. Patrick's Cemetery") has no readable record ID; its contents are unverified.

---

Here is the source evaluation for **Christian P. Hole (KD96-TV2)**:

---

## Sources on Christian P. Hole (KD96-TV2) — 4 Attached, 2 User-Actionable Findings

### 1. "Minnesota Death Index, 1908–2002" — Possible Indexing Error
- **Link:** https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:HOLE-002
- The indexed death date is **10 June 1954**, but the profile records **10 Jun 1945**. Everything else (name, place: Erskine, Polk, Minnesota; birth year 1875) agrees.
- **Kind:** Likely an index keying error, though a different Christian P. Hole dying in Erskine in 1954 cannot be entirely excluded without the original.
- **Action:** Re-read the original death certificate or register. If the index is wrong, correct it on FamilySearch. **Keep this source attached** while you investigate.

---

### 2. "Minnesota State Census, 1885" — Misattributed
- **Link:** https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:HOLE-003
- The record names Christian (b. 1852, Norway), wife Bergit (b. 1856), son Nils (b. 1879), residing in **Aurdal, Otter Tail County** in 1885. The profile records birth **1875**, wife **Inger**, son **Ole C.**, and residence in **Polk County** — none of these match.
- This record already belongs to **KD96-WX7** (a different Christian Hole, b. 1852, Norway, d. Aurdal 1919), whose facts fit the 1885 census perfectly.
- **Action:** **Detach this source from KD96-TV2.** It is misattributed and correctly belongs to KD96-WX7.

---

### Could Not Check
- **"Hole family photograph and funeral card (uploaded memory)"** — No readable record ID. The title references a 1945 funeral card, which is a worthwhile lead to verify the death date, but cannot be evaluated here.

---

### Sourcing Gap (Not a Defect)
- The **marriage of 1 May 1898** has no attached source bearing on it.

---

### Data Warnings (from project tree)
- **Contradiction:** A Residence event dated 1950 appears more than 1 year after the recorded death of 10 Jun 1945.
- **Implausible:** At least one place on this person is not linked to a standard place.

---

**Summary:** Detach the 1885 Minnesota State Census immediately (it's the wrong person). Investigate the death date discrepancy in the Minnesota Death Index by checking the original certificate. The 1950 Residence event should also be reviewed given the 1945 death date.

Here is what the source-evaluation agent found for **Christian P. Hole (KD96-TV2)**:

---

## Sources Reviewed (4 attached, 2 findings)

### ❌ Finding 1 — Misattributed source
**Minnesota State Census, 1885**
The indexed record shows a Christian Hole born **1852** in Norway, living in Aurdal, Otter Tail County in 1885 with wife Bergit and son Nils. Christian P. Hole's profile records a birth year of **1875** and a 1900 Polk County household with wife Inger — a 23-year birth year discrepancy that is far beyond census drift, and the household does not match at all. This same record is already attached to **KD96-WX7** (a different Christian Hole, born 1852, died 1919 in Aurdal), where it fits perfectly.

> **Action: Detach this record from KD96-TV2. It belongs to KD96-WX7.**

---

### ⚠️ Finding 2 — Possible indexing error
**Minnesota Death Index, 1908–2002**
The index records death **10 June 1954**; the profile records **10 June 1945**. Name, place (Erskine, Polk, Minnesota), and birth year (1875, Norway) all agree — only the year differs. Because this is an index-only collection with no image, the original death certificate is needed to settle which year is correct.

> **Action: Obtain the original death certificate to verify the year — 1945 or 1954.**

---

### ✅ No finding — United States Census, 1900
Birth year of 1877 in the index vs. 1875 on the profile is within normal census variance, and the residence in Fairview, Polk, Minnesota agrees. This source is correctly attached.

---

### ⬜ Could not check — Uploaded memory (funeral card)
The uploaded funeral card has no readable record ID and cannot be read programmatically. Its uploader's title cites 1945, which is a lead supporting the profile's death year — worth examining alongside Finding 2.

---

### FamilySearch completeness notes (not errors, just suggestions)
- Marriage place is missing a city.
- The marriage has no tagged sources.

## Sources Audit: Christian P. Hole (KD96-TV2) — 4 sources checked, 2 findings

### ⚠️ Finding 1 — Possible Indexing Error
**"Minnesota Death Index, 1908–2002"** ([link](https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:HOLE-002))

The index gives a death date of **10 June 1954**, but the profile records **10 June 1945**. The name, birth year (1875, Norway), and death place (Erskine, Polk, Minnesota) all match — only the death year differs.

An index error is the likelier explanation, but a same-named man who died in Erskine in 1954 cannot be ruled out from this profile alone.

**Next step:** Consult the original Minnesota death certificate. Keep the source attached until then.

---

### ❌ Finding 2 — Misattributed Source
**"Minnesota State Census, 1885"** ([link](https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:HOLE-003))

The indexed person is Christian, born **1852** in Norway, residing in Aurdal, Otter Tail, Minnesota in 1885, with wife Bergit and son Nils. Christian P. Hole was born **1875**, had wife Inger, and son Ole C. — the household does not match at all.

This same record is also attached to **KD96-WX7** (Christian Hole, born 1852 Norway, died Aurdal 1919), whose facts fit the record perfectly.

**Next step:** **Detach** this record from Christian P. Hole. It belongs to KD96-WX7.

---

### ✅ No Finding
**"United States Census, 1900"** — The birth year of 1877 vs. the profile's 1875 is ordinary census drift. Wife Inger, son Ole C., and Fairview residence all match. No problem.

---

**"Hole family photograph and funeral card (uploaded memory)"** — An uploaded image with no readable record ID. The funeral card likely corroborates nothing independently, but it may help settle the 1945 vs. 1954 death-year question if you review the image yourself.

---

- **Sourcing gaps:** No sources cover residences 1895 and 1910–1930, and the 1898 marriage has no tagged sources.
- **FamilySearch suggestions:** A marriage place is missing a city; the marriage has no tagged sources.
- The findings have been logged to the research log as **log_001**.

Here is the source-evaluation report for **Cornelius Driscoll (GJ72-9WD)**:

---

## Sources Evaluated — 7 attached, 2 findings, 1 conflict handed off

---

### Finding 1 — Indexing Error (year of marriage)
**Record:** "Quebec, Vital and Church Records (Drouin Collection), 1621–1968"
[https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:DRIS-002](https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:DRIS-002)

The index shows a marriage on **9 June 1845** at St. Patrick's, Sherbrooke; the profile records **9 June 1849**. Names, place, and day/month all agree — only the year differs. Likely an indexing error, but the register image must be re-read to determine which side has the wrong year.

**Action:** Open the marriage register image and check the actual year.

---

### Finding 2 — Indexing Error (place of residence)
**Record:** "Census of Canada East, 1851"
[https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:DRIS-005](https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:DRIS-005)

The index shows **Melbourne, Canada East**; the profile records **Sherbrooke, Canada East**. Name and Irish birthplace agree. No image is attached to the index, so the original census schedule should be located.

**Action:** Do not detach this source; re-read the original 1851 census schedule to verify the place.

---

### Conflict Handed to Conflict-Resolution
Two sources disagree on when Cornelius died:
- **Quebec, Catholic Parish Registers burial** → died/buried **April 1878** at St. Patrick's Cemetery
- **Quebec, Civil Registration Deaths, 1867–1900** → death **2 February 1885**, Sherbrooke

The profile carries no death fact and an undated burial. This source-vs.-source disagreement needs to go to **conflict-resolution** to determine which date is correct.

---

### Sources That Agree (not flagged)
- **Ireland, Catholic Parish Registers** — christening 12 March 1814, Skibbereen → consistent with profile birth year 1814 ✓
- **Quebec, Census of Canada 1861** — birth year 1816, residence Sherbrooke → within normal census variance of 1814 ✓

---

### Could Not Check
- A **headstone photograph** uploaded to FamilySearch Memories (St. Patrick's Cemetery) could not be opened as a record. It may be a useful lead on the 1878 vs. 1885 death date question, but it cannot serve as evidence here.

---

### Sourcing Gap
The profile has **no recorded death fact**, leaving the 1878 vs. 1885 question unresolved.

---

### Implausibility Note (from tree check)
One or more places on this person are not linked to a standard/recognized place entry in the tree — worth cleaning up for consistency.

Here is the source evaluation for **Christian P. Hole (KD96-TV2)**:

---

## Source Audit — 2 Findings

### Finding 1: Minnesota Death Index, 1908–2002 — Likely Indexing Error
- **Issue:** The index records a death date of **10 June 1954**, but the profile shows **10 June 1945**. All other fields (birth year 1875, place) agree.
- **Action:** Check the original death certificate. If it reads 1945, correct the index entry. Keep the source attached — it is otherwise valid evidence.

---

### Finding 2: Minnesota State Census, 1885 — Misattributed Source
- **Issue:** This record gives a birth year of **1852** (profile says 1875 — far outside normal census drift), residence in Aurdal, Otter Tail, and lists household members Bergit and Nils — none of whom match this profile's family.
- **This source belongs to a different person:** It matches **KD96-WX7** (another Christian Hole, born 1852 in Norway, resided in Aurdal, died there 1919).
- **Action:** **Detach this source from KD96-TV2.** It is a misattribution.

---

## Other Notes

- **1900 U.S. Census:** Birth year shown as 1877 vs. the profile's 1875 — this is normal census drift. No action needed.
- **Uploaded funeral card memory:** Cites a death in 1945, consistent with the profile. Cannot be read as a structured record, but worth checking against the original.
- **FamilySearch suggestions (not errors):** Marriage place is missing a city; marriage has no tagged sources.

---

The audit has been logged to the project's research log as **log_001**.
